# Section: Table 1
**Path:** Anejo C. Resistencia al fuego de las estructuras de hormigón armado → C.2  Tablas → C.2.2 Soportes y muros → Table 1
**Level:** 4
**Tags:** Resistencia, Fuego, Las, Estructuras, Hormigón, Armado, Tablas, Soportes, Muros, Table
**Pages:** 58-58


| Resistencia al fuego | Lado menor o espesor bmín / Distancia mínima equivalente al eje am (mm)(1) |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | Soportes | Muro de carga expuesto  por una cara | Muro de carga expuesto  por ambas caras |
| R 30 | 150 / 15(2) | 100 / 15(3) | 120 / 15 |
| R 60 | 200/ 20(2) | 120 / 15(3) | 140 / 15 |
| R 90 | 250 /30 | 140 / 20(3) | 160 / 25 |
| R 120 | 250 / 40 | 160 / 25(3) | 180 / 35 |
| R 180 | 350 / 45 | 200 / 40(3) | 250 / 45 |
| R 240 | 400 / 50 | 250 / 50(3) | 300 / 50 |

attributes.norm_statement: The fire resistance of concrete structures must comply with the minimum dimensions and equivalent axis distances specified in Table 1 for supports and walls.
attributes.satisfied_if: FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 'R30' AND ((STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'SUPPORT' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 150 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 15) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'ONE_SIDE' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 100 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 15) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'BOTH_SIDES' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 120 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 15)); OR FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 'R60' AND ((STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'SUPPORT' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 200 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 20) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'ONE_SIDE' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 120 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 15) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'BOTH_SIDES' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 140 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 15)); OR FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 'R90' AND ((STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'SUPPORT' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 250 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 30) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'ONE_SIDE' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 140 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 20) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'BOTH_SIDES' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 160 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 25)); OR FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 'R120' AND ((STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'SUPPORT' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 250 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 40) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'ONE_SIDE' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 160 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 25) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'BOTH_SIDES' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 180 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 35)); OR FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 'R180' AND ((STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'SUPPORT' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 350 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 45) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'ONE_SIDE' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 200 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 40) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'BOTH_SIDES' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 250 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 45)); OR FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 'R240' AND ((STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'SUPPORT' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 400 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 50) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'ONE_SIDE' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 250 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 50) OR (STRUCTURE.ELEMENT == 'LOAD_BEARING_WALL' AND WALL.EXPOSURE == 'BOTH_SIDES' AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.MIN_SIDE_OR_THICKNESS >= 300 AND STRUCTURE.DIMENSION.EQUIVALENT_AXIS_DISTANCE >= 50)
attributes.notes: The table provides specific values for minimum side/thickness and equivalent axis distance based on fire resistance rating (R) and element type (support, load-bearing wall with one or both sides exposed).
